ko.title: LLM 시스템 엔지니어링: 모델, 하드웨어, 워크로드를 연결하는 일
ko.description: 모델·하드웨어·워크로드로 실행 시스템을 이해하는 관점과 시리즈의 학습 순서를 소개합니다.

en.title: LLM Systems Engineering: Connecting Models, Hardware, and Workloads
en.description: An introduction to understanding execution systems through models, hardware, and workloads, and the learning path for this series.
en.reviewNote: Korean and English bodies compared for publication on 2026-09-08; model, hardware, workload definitions and learning roadmap match.

ko.title: LLM의 전체 구조: 임베딩 층에서 LM Head까지
ko.description: 텍스트가 토큰 ID와 벡터를 거쳐 어휘별 점수로 바뀌는 흐름과 임베딩 층, 디코더 블록, LM Head의 역할을 살펴봅니다.

en.title: The Structure of an LLM: From the Embedding Layer to the LM Head
en.description: Follow text through token IDs, vectors, and vocabulary scores, and explore the roles of the embedding layer, decoder blocks, and LM Head.
en.reviewNote: Compared Korean and English text section by section on 2026-09-09. Token IDs, dimensions, lookup order, context explanation, and logits semantics match; five English figures share the Korean geometry and illustrative values.

ko.title: 디코더 블록의 기본 흐름: Residual과 RMSNorm
ko.description: Residual stream을 중심으로 디코더 블록의 구조를 살펴보고, d차원 벡터의 덧셈과 RMSNorm의 계산을 설명합니다.

en.title: The Flow Through a Decoder Block: Residual Connections and RMSNorm
en.description: Explore a decoder block around its residual stream, then follow vector addition and RMSNorm across each token’s d components.
en.reviewNote: Compared all four sections and figure descriptions with the Korean source on 2026-09-09. Residual paths, dimensions, RMS/epsilon/gamma explanations and final normalization agree. English figures preserve the Korean geometry and numerical examples.

ko.title: Attention과 MLP: 토큰 사이의 정보와 토큰 내부의 변환
ko.description: Attention과 MLP의 역할을 비교하고, 행렬 곱부터 기본 MLP와 Gated MLP의 내부 계산까지 살펴봅니다.

en.title: Attention and MLP: Information Across Tokens and Transformations Within a Token
en.description: Compare Attention and MLP, then explore matrix multiplication and the computations inside basic and gated MLPs.
en.reviewNote: Compared all five sections, examples, symbols, alt text, and the closing paragraph with the approved Korean source on 2026-09-09. All five English figures retain the Korean geometry and numerical values, including the latest wording and deletions in Figure 1.

ko.title: Attention의 projection: Q·K·V와 멀티 헤드
ko.description: Q·K·V projection과 멀티 헤드의 구성을 살펴보고, 출력 projection이 같은 토큰의 여러 head 결과를 조합하는 과정을 설명합니다.

en.title: Attention Projections: Q, K, V and Multiple Heads
en.description: Explore Q, K and V projections, the organization of multiple heads, and how the output projection combines head results for the same token.
en.reviewNote: Compared all four sections, symbols, dimensions, emphasis, figure alt text and the closing paragraph with the approved Korean source on 2026-09-09. Token independence, full-input projections and head mixing match. All four English figures preserve the Korean geometry and example dimensions; both language versions were visually inspected.

ko.title: Core Attention: 토큰 사이의 정보 조합하기
ko.description: Head별 Core Attention의 흐름을 따라 QKᵀ, 스케일링, Causal mask, Softmax, Value 가중합을 살펴봅니다.

en.title: Core Attention: Combining Information Across Tokens
en.description: Follow Core Attention within each head through QKᵀ, scaling, a causal mask, Softmax, and a weighted sum of Value vectors.
en.reviewNote: Compared all five sections, numerical examples, dimensions, inline formulas, emphasis, alt text and the closing paragraph with the approved Korean source on 2026-09-09. Matching-head computation, causal masking, row-wise Softmax and Value aggregation agree. English figures share the Korean geometry and illustrative values; final visual review is recorded separately.

ko.title: RoPE: 토큰 위치를 Attention에 반영하기
ko.description: Q와 K의 성분을 토큰 위치에 따라 회전하는 방법과, 상대 위치가 Attention 점수에 반영되는 과정을 살펴봅니다.

en.title: RoPE: Incorporating Token Positions into Attention
en.description: Explore how RoPE rotates the components of Q and K by token position and how relative positions affect Attention scores.
en.reviewNote: Compared all six sections, paragraphs, emphasis, examples, dimensions, alt text, and three MathML equations against the approved Korean source on 2026-09-10. Token-wise rotation, causal-mask scope, illustrative versus base frequencies, relative positions, and score changes agree. Both figure languages share geometry and numerical values; final visual review is recorded separately.

ko.title: MoE: 토큰마다 사용할 MLP 선택하기
ko.description: Dense MLP와 MoE를 비교하고, Router의 선택과 가중치 계산부터 Dispatch, Expert 계산, Combine, Shared expert까지 살펴봅니다.

en.title: MoE: Choosing Which MLPs to Use for Each Token
en.description: Compare dense MLPs and MoE, then follow routing, dispatch, expert computation, combination, and the shared expert path.
en.reviewNote: Compared all four sections, paragraphs, emphasis, example values, dimensions, alt text and the closing paragraph with the approved Korean source on 2026-09-10. The deleted Mixtral paragraph remains removed. Parameter storage, token-wise routing, weighted combination and shared versus routed experts agree. Four English figures retain Korean geometry and numerical values; web visual review is recorded separately.

ko.title: 모델 전체 흐름 다시 보기
ko.description: Embedding부터 LM Head까지 구성 요소를 연결하고, Attention과 MLP·MoE의 역할과 토큰 사이의 정보가 합쳐지는 위치를 정리합니다.

en.title: Revisiting the Flow Through the Model
en.description: Connect the components from Embedding to the LM Head, review Attention and MLP or MoE, and identify where information is combined across tokens.
en.reviewNote: Compared all four sections, 17 paragraphs, emphasis, dimensions, symbols and alt text against the approved Korean source on 2026-09-10. Residual paths, MHA shapes, RoPE placement, masking before Softmax, gated MLP and MoE paths, and token dependencies agree. The revised third heading is retained. Four English figures preserve Korean geometry; web visual review is recorded separately.

ko.title: CPU와 GPU: 모델의 계산을 실행하는 두 장치
ko.description: GPU를 사용하는 이유와 CPU·GPU의 구조 차이를 살펴보고, Host·Device의 실행 흐름과 데이터 공급의 중요성을 설명합니다.

en.title: CPU and GPU: Two Devices That Execute Model Computation
en.description: Explore why GPUs are used, how CPU and GPU designs differ, how host and device work together, and why compute units need a supply of data.
en.reviewNote: Compared all four sections, 17 paragraphs, 17 emphasized passages, numerical examples, alt text and source links against the approved Korean source on 2026-09-10. The requested deletion and revised Host and completion wording are preserved. Four English figures share Korean geometry and the latest figure 3 and 4 edits; static assets were compared separately from the body revision.

ko.title: GPU 구조: 연산 장치와 메모리
ko.description: SM과 CUDA Core·Tensor Core, GPU 메모리의 구성을 살펴보고, 용량·대역폭·접근 지연을 모델 실행의 문제와 연결합니다.

en.title: GPU Architecture: Compute Units and Memory
en.description: Explore SMs, CUDA Cores, Tensor Cores, and GPU memory, then connect capacity, bandwidth, and access latency to running a model.
en.reviewNote: Compared all four sections, 28 prose paragraphs, six memory-table rows, emphasis, example values, alt text, and source links against the approved Korean source on 2026-09-10. The B200 148-SM capacity calculations, shared L1/shared-memory allocation, developer control, and bandwidth versus access latency distinctions agree. All four English figures preserve Korean geometry and values; static assets were reviewed separately from the body revision.

ko.title: 모델 연산의 병렬성: 원소별 연산, Reduction, 행렬 곱
ko.description: 원소별 연산, reduction, 행렬 곱을 출력 요소의 독립성과 결과 하나에 필요한 입력·계산의 관점에서 비교합니다.

en.title: Parallelism in Model Operations: Element-wise Operations, Reductions, and Matrix Multiplication
en.description: Compare element-wise operations, reductions, and matrix multiplication through independent output elements and the inputs and computation needed for each result.
en.reviewNote: Compared all four sections, 21 prose paragraphs, 16 emphasized passages, numerical examples, dimensions, inline calculations, and alt text against the approved Korean source on 2026-09-11. Requested deletions are preserved. Independent output elements, partial-sum dependencies, K-axis accumulation, and shared inputs agree. Four English figures preserve Korean shapes, coordinates, and numerical labels; static assets are compared separately from the body revision.

ko.title: GPU의 병렬 실행: 작업 배정과 Warp 스케줄링
ko.description: 커널·thread·block·grid의 관계와 SM 자원 배정, warp 스케줄링과 지연 숨기기를 작은 벡터 덧셈 예시로 설명합니다.

en.title: Parallel Execution on GPUs: Work Assignment and Warp Scheduling
en.description: Explore kernels, threads, blocks, and grids, then connect SM resource allocation, warp scheduling, and latency hiding through a small vector addition example.
en.reviewNote: Compared all five sections, 31 prose paragraphs, 25 emphasized passages, examples, alt text, and source links against the approved Korean source on 2026-09-11. The kernel-thread-block-grid introduction before Figure 1, 128 threads per block, resource scopes, resident versus eligible warps, instruction issue, and latency hiding agree. Repetitive caveat deletions are preserved. Five English figures retain Korean geometry and values; static assets were compared separately from the body revision and visually reviewed.
